Services

One team for every part of a UGC ad.

hypjam is a UGC agency in London. Its nine services cover everything between a product and a finished ad: the brief and the script, the hooks, casting from our own creator roster, direction on the shoot day, the edit and captions, whitelisting and Spark Ads, usage rights, reporting, and founder-led video for when you are the one on camera. Book one or all of them; the same people run each.
